scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n FRONTEND,BACKEND -c auto "npm run dev:frontend" "npm run dev:backend"
scripts.lint: concurrently -k -n LINT-FRONTEND,LINT-BACKEND -c auto "npm run lint:frontend" "npm run lint:backend"
scripts.format: concurrently -k -n FMT-FRONTEND,FMT-BACKEND -c auto "npm run format:frontend" "npm run format:backend"
scripts.type-check: concurrently -k -n TC-FRONTEND,TC-BACKEND -c auto "npm run type-check:frontend" "npm run type-check:backend"
scripts.start: concurrently -k -n FRONTEND,BACKEND -c auto "npm run start:frontend" "npm run start:backend"
